Carlos: Good idea; they're usually quick and reasonably priced.
o: Yes, I fixed everything myself in half an hour.
No, I sold it last week to a student.
Not at all; I've never owned a bike.
Yes, my neighbour helped me and it rides like new.
Not really; I replaced the tyre, but the brakes still don't work properly.
q.e: Elena 'take it to the repair shop' diyerek bisikletin tam onarılmadığını ima eder; doğru şık kısmi onarımı anlatır. Diğerleri sorunun çözüldüğünü ya da bisikletin olmadığını söyler.

q.q:
Lucy: Our team lost the match again.
Harry: ----
Lucy: I agree. We need to train harder and communicate better on the pitch.
Harry: Let's talk to the coach tomorrow.
o: It's frustrating, but we've been making the same mistakes every game.
It's a shame, but the other team had much better players.
It's surprising, because we've been playing so well recently.
It's fine; the referee clearly made several wrong decisions.
It's annoying, but winning isn't really important to me.
q.e: Lucy 'I agree. We need to train harder' diyerek Harry'nin hatalardan söz ettiğini gösterir. Diğer şıklar hakemi ya da rakibi suçlar, başarıyı önemsemez ya da şaşkınlık bildirir.

q.q:
Adam: I'm worried about the exam results.
Bella: ----
Adam: I know, but the final question was really difficult.
Bella: Everyone found it hard, so the grading will probably be generous.
o: Try not to think about it; let's go for a coffee.
You didn't revise much, so I'd be worried too.
You studied for weeks, so I'm sure you did well.
Don't forget that the results come out on Monday.
The results will probably be posted on the website tonight.
q.e: Adam 'I know, but the final question was really difficult' diyerek bir teselliye karşılık verir; boşlukta rahatlatıcı söz olmalıdır. Diğer şıklar suçlayıcıdır ya da sonuç tarihinden söz eder.

q.q:
Receptionist: Good morning. How can I help you?
Guest: ----
Receptionist: Let me check. Would you prefer a room with a view of the garden or the sea?
Guest: The sea, please, if it's available.
o: Could you tell me where the nearest pharmacy is?
I'd like to book a double room for three nights, please.
I have a reservation under the name of Wilson.
I'd like to check out and pay my bill, please.
I'd like to book a table for dinner tonight, please.
q.e: Resepsiyonist 'Would you prefer a room with a view...' diyerek oda ayrılacağını gösterir; misafir oda rezervasyonu istemiştir. Diğerleri çıkış, mevcut rezervasyon ya da yemek ile ilgilidir.

q.q:
Fiona: Why are you studying so late tonight?
George: ----
Fiona: Then you'd better get some rest; you can't concentrate when you're exhausted.
George: You're right. I'll go to bed after this chapter.
o: I'm not tired at all; I usually go to bed at four.
I have a major presentation tomorrow, and I'm not fully prepared.
I'm helping my sister with her homework over the phone.
I finished all my work yesterday, so I'm just reading for fun.
I enjoy studying at night because the house is so quiet.
q.e: Fiona 'Then you'd better get some rest' diyerek George'un yorgun ve gergin olduğunu ima eder; hazırlıksız sunum bu nedeni açıklar. Diğer şıklar rahat ya da yorgun olmayan bir durumu anlatır.

q.q:
Nathan: I can't decide which smartphone to buy.
Olga: ----
Nathan: Mostly taking photos and watching videos.
Olga: Then choose the one with the best camera and battery life.
o: Which brand is your current phone?
Where did you buy your last one?
Do you prefer a big screen or a compact one?
How much are you willing to spend on it?
What do you mainly use your phone for?
q.e: Nathan 'Mostly taking photos and watching videos' diyerek kullanım amacını söyler; soru telefonun ne için kullanıldığıdır. Diğerleri bütçe, marka, ekran ya da satın alma yeriyle ilgilidir.

q.q:
Chloe: Many farmers are struggling with the drought this year.
Ian: ----
Chloe: Some are switching to crops that need less water.
Ian: That seems sensible, though it must be expensive to change.
o: Yes, it's a serious issue. Which regions have been hit hardest?
Yes, it's a serious issue. When did it last rain properly?
Yes, it's a serious issue. Is the government giving them any money?
Yes, it's a serious issue. Will food prices go up this winter?
Yes, it's a serious issue. How are they coping with it?
q.e: Chloe 'Some are switching to crops that need less water' diyerek çiftçilerin nasıl baş ettiğini anlatır. Diğer şıklar yağış, fiyat, devlet desteği ya da bölge sorar.

q.q:
Ruth: Could you lend me your notes from yesterday's lecture?
Michael: ----
Ruth: Oh, that's a pity. Do you know anyone who attended the whole session?
Michael: Try asking Jenny; she always writes everything down.
o: Of course; I'll bring them to the library in an hour.
I'm sorry, but I actually missed it myself.
Sure, I'll email them to you tonight.
Sure, but my handwriting is hard to read.
Yes, take the photos I took of the slides.
q.e: Ruth 'Oh, that's a pity' diyerek olumsuz bir yanıt aldığını gösterir. Diğer şıklar notları vereceğini söyler; bu üzüntüyle ve devamdaki soruyla çelişir.

q.q:
Alice: Why is the train station so crowded today?
Bob: ----
Alice: I had no idea. Do you think trains will be running on time?
Bob: Probably not; many services have been cancelled.
o: They're repairing the ticket machines, so queues have formed.
There's a strike by railway workers, so many passengers are stranded.
A big football match ends in the city this afternoon.
I think there's a concert in the city centre tonight.
It's the start of the holiday season, and everyone is travelling.
q.e: Bob'un 'many services have been cancelled' demesi, grev gibi ciddi bir aksama olduğunu gösterir. Diğer şıklar iptallere yol açmayan nedenler sunar.

q.q:
Dan: The new policy requires everyone to wear a badge in the office.
Eva: ----
Dan: For security reasons, apparently, after some equipment went missing.
Eva: Well, that's understandable, though it's a bit inconvenient.
o: Really? Will visitors have to wear one too?
Really? Who will design the badges?
Really? When does it come into force?
Really? What's the purpose of that rule?
Really? Did the manager announce it by email?
q.e: Dan 'For security reasons, apparently' diyerek kuralın amacını açıklar; soru amaçla ilgili olmalıdır. Diğer şıklar tarih, tasarım, ziyaretçi ya da duyuru biçimi sorar.

q.q:
Mia: Do you know why the bakery on the corner closed down?
Leo: ----
Mia: That's sad; it had been there for over forty years.
Leo: I know, and the neighbourhood won't be the same without it.
o: The owner retired, and none of his children wanted to take over.
The bakery reopened under new management last week.
It was only open for a few months before it failed.
Nobody knows; I never went there.
They moved to a bigger shop in the next town; it's even better now.
q.e: Mia 'it had been there for over forty years' diyerek üzüldüğünü belirtir; bu yüzden nedenin üzücü ve uzun süreli bir işletmeyle uyumlu olması gerekir. Diğerleri kısa ömürlü, iyi sonuçlu ya da bilgisiz yanıtlardır.

q.q:
Isabel: I've decided to take a gap year before starting university.
Tom: ----
Isabel: I'd like to volunteer abroad and learn a new language.
Tom: That sounds like a valuable experience, as long as you stay motivated.
o: Interesting. When did you finish school?
Interesting. Why did you choose that course?
Interesting. Have your parents agreed to pay for it?
Interesting. Which university will you apply to?
Interesting. What are you planning to do during that time?
q.e: Isabel 'I'd like to volunteer abroad' diyerek planını anlatır; boşlukta yıl boyunca neler yapacağı sorulmuştur. Diğer şıklar üniversite, aile desteği ya da geçmişle ilgilidir.

q.q: (I) Urban green spaces provide significant benefits for city residents. (II) Parks reduce air pollution and lower temperatures in crowded districts. (III) Property prices in central districts have risen sharply as city populations have grown. (IV) Regular access to trees and gardens has been linked to lower stress levels. (V) Such areas also encourage physical activity among people of all ages.
q.e: Paragraf kentsel yeşil alanların faydaları üzerinedir. III numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de konut fiyatları alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) Antibiotic resistance has become one of the most serious threats to global health. (II) It occurs when bacteria evolve in ways that make drugs ineffective. (III) The overuse of antibiotics in medicine and farming accelerates this process. (IV) As a result, common infections may become much harder to treat. (V) Research funding for new antibiotics has declined because such drugs bring pharmaceutical companies little profit.
q.e: Paragraf antibiyotik direnci üzerinedir. V numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de ilaç sektörünün finansman sorunları alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) The Industrial Revolution transformed European society in the nineteenth century. (II) Many historians argue that the French Revolution was triggered by a prolonged food crisis and heavy taxation. (III) Factories replaced small workshops as the main centres of production. (IV) Millions of people moved from villages to rapidly growing cities. (V) Working conditions were often harsh, with long hours and low pay.
q.e: Paragraf Sanayi Devrimi'nin toplumsal etkileri üzerinedir. II numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de Fransız Devrimi'nin nedenleri alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) Inflation reduces the purchasing power of money over time. (II) When prices rise faster than wages, households can afford fewer goods. (III) Central banks often respond by increasing interest rates. (IV) Higher rates make borrowing more expensive and slow down spending. (V) Gold was the basis of most national currencies until the early twentieth century.
q.e: Paragraf enflasyon ve faiz politikası üzerinedir. V numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de altın standardı alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) Social media has changed the way young people communicate. (II) Instant messaging allows friends to stay in touch across continents. (III) However, constant online comparison can damage self-esteem. (IV) Online advertising revenue has grown faster than that of newspapers and television combined. (V) Some studies suggest that heavy use is associated with poorer sleep.
q.e: Paragraf sosyal medyanın gençler üzerindeki etkisi üzerinedir. IV numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de çevrimiçi reklam gelirleri alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) Coral reefs are among the most diverse ecosystems on Earth. (II) They shelter about a quarter of all marine species despite covering a tiny area. (III) Many commercial fishing fleets operate near reefs because the surrounding waters are rich in valuable species. (IV) Rising sea temperatures cause corals to expel the algae that feed them. (V) This process, known as bleaching, often leads to widespread coral death.
q.e: Paragraf mercan resiflerinin zenginliği ve beyazlaşma üzerinedir. III numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de ticari balıkçılık alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) Regular exercise has well-documented effects on mental health. (II) Professional athletes are often exposed to a higher risk of joint injuries than people who exercise recreationally. (III) Physical activity stimulates the release of chemicals that improve mood. (IV) People who exercise regularly often report lower levels of anxiety. (V) It can also improve concentration and memory in older adults.
q.e: Paragraf egzersizin ruh sağlığına etkisi üzerinedir. II numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de profesyonel sporcuların sakatlanma riski alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) Energy-saving bulbs have significantly reduced household electricity bills in many countries. (II) Artificial lighting has altered the natural rhythms of many animals. (III) Migratory birds are often drawn to bright city lights and collide with buildings. (IV) Newly hatched sea turtles may head inland instead of toward the ocean. (V) Insects that depend on darkness for mating find their cycles disrupted.
q.e: Paragraf ışık kirliliğinin hayvanlara etkisi üzerinedir. I numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de aydınlatmada enerji tasarrufu alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) University tuition fees have risen sharply in many countries over the past two decades. (II) Early childhood education plays a crucial role in later academic success. (III) Children who attend quality preschools tend to develop stronger language skills. (IV) They also learn to cooperate and manage their emotions more effectively. (V) Long-term studies show that these children are more likely to finish secondary school.
q.e: Paragraf erken çocukluk eğitiminin önemi üzerinedir. I numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de üniversite harçları alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) Renewable energy sources are becoming increasingly competitive. (II) The cost of solar panels has fallen dramatically over the past decade. (III) Wind farms now supply a substantial share of electricity in several countries. (IV) Nuclear power plants produce large amounts of radioactive waste that must be stored safely for thousands of years. (V) Storage technologies are gradually solving the problem of intermittent supply.
q.e: Paragraf yenilenebilir enerjinin rekabet gücü üzerinedir. IV numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de nükleer atık alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) Sleep deprivation has serious consequences for cognitive performance. (II) Tired individuals find it harder to concentrate on complex tasks. (III) Newborn babies spend most of the day asleep and wake mainly to be fed. (IV) Reaction times slow down, which increases the risk of accidents. (V) Memory consolidation, which occurs during deep sleep, is also impaired.
q.e: Paragraf uyku yoksunluğunun bilişsel sonuçları üzerinedir. III numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de yenidoğanların uyku düzeni alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) Globalisation has reshaped the way goods are produced and sold. (II) Companies now manufacture components in several countries before assembling the final product. (III) This arrangement lowers costs but makes supply chains vulnerable to disruption. (IV) English has become the dominant language of international diplomacy and science. (V) Consumers benefit from cheaper products and a wider variety of choice.
q.e: Paragraf küreselleşmenin üretim ve ticarete etkisi üzerinedir. IV numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de uluslararası dil kullanımı alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) Cybersecurity is a growing concern for businesses of all sizes. (II) Hackers often target employees through deceptive emails known as phishing. (III) A single successful attack can expose confidential customer data. (IV) Companies are therefore investing in staff training and stronger authentication. (V) Online shopping has expanded rapidly because customers value convenience and a wide range of choices.
q.e: Paragraf işletmeler için siber güvenlik üzerinedir. V numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de çevrimiçi alışverişin yaygınlaşması alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) The Renaissance marked a turning point in European art and thought. (II) Painters began to use perspective to create more realistic scenes. (III) Medieval cathedrals were built over several generations by stonemasons who rarely saw the finished building. (IV) Scholars rediscovered classical texts from ancient Greece and Rome. (V) Wealthy patrons in Italian city-states funded artists and architects.
q.e: Paragraf Rönesans dönemi sanat ve düşünce üzerinedir. III numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de Orta Çağ katedralleri alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) Microplastics have been found in oceans, rivers and even drinking water. (II) They originate from the breakdown of larger plastic items and synthetic clothing fibres. (III) Marine animals mistake the tiny particles for food and swallow them. (IV) Governments in several countries have introduced deposit schemes to encourage the return of plastic bottles. (V) The long-term effects on human health are still being investigated.
q.e: Paragraf mikroplastik kirliliği üzerinedir. IV numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de şişe depozito uygulamaları alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) Bilingualism offers several cognitive advantages. (II) Learning a foreign language as an adult usually requires more time and effort than learning one in childhood. (III) People who speak two languages regularly switch between them with ease. (IV) This constant mental exercise seems to improve attention and problem-solving. (V) Some research even suggests that it delays the onset of dementia.
q.e: Paragraf iki dilliliğin bilişsel yararları üzerinedir. II numaralı cümle aynı genel konuya yakın görünse de yetişkinlerde yabancı dil öğrenmenin zorluğu alt konusuna kayar ve akışı bozar; diğer dört cümle birbirini tamamlayarak paragrafın odağını sürdürür.

q.q: (I) Historic city centres in Europe attract millions of tourists who admire their architecture. (II) Urbanisation is progressing rapidly in developing countries. (III) Each year, millions of people leave rural areas in search of better jobs. (IV) Cities struggle to provide enough housing, transport and clean water. This drug was withdrawn from the market in several countries after its serious side effects had been eliminated.

q.e: Geri çekme geçmişte yapılmış; gerekçe yan etkilerin ciddi olabilme ihtimali; ülke sayısı birkaç. Diğerlerinde gerekçe, zaman, ülke sayısı veya eylem (öneri) değişiyor.

q.q: Genç mimar, tasarımının kentin tarihî dokusuna uyum sağlaması için eski yapıların özelliklerini ayrıntılı biçimde incelemişti.
o: The young architect has designed old buildings in detail so that they harmonize with the city's historic fabric.
The young architect had examined the features of old buildings in detail so that his design would harmonize with the historic fabric of the city.
The young architect had ignored the features of old buildings so that his design would stand out from the historic fabric of the city.
The young architect examined the features of old buildings in detail after his design had harmonized with the historic fabric of the city.
The young architect had examined the features of old buildings in detail because his design had destroyed the historic fabric of the city.
q.e: Amaç (so that ... would harmonize) ve geçmişte-geçmiş (had examined). Diğerlerinde amaç-sonuç sırası, eylem veya anlam çarpıtılıyor.

q.q: Ekonomik büyümenin sürdürülebilir olabilmesi için doğal kaynakların bilinçli biçimde kullanılması ve çevrenin korunması şarttır.
o: For economic growth to be sustainable, it is essential to use natural resources consciously and to protect the environment.
Sustainable economic growth is impossible unless natural resources are consciously used, but protecting the environment is optional.
Economic growth is sustainable as long as natural resources are used consciously, even if the environment is not protected.
For natural resources to be used consciously, economic growth must be sustainable and the environment must be protected.
For economic growth to be sustainable, it is essential to use natural resources quickly and to exploit the environment.
q.e: Amaç: sürdürülebilir büyüme; şart: bilinçli kaynak kullanımı VE çevrenin korunması. Diğerlerinde amaç-şart ilişkisi ters, çevre koruma isteğe bağlı veya anlam zıt.

q.q: Had the committee reviewed the data more carefully, it would not have approved the drug so quickly.
o: The committee will approve the drug once it has reviewed the data carefully.
The committee approved the drug quickly because it did not review the data carefully enough.
The committee refused to approve the drug because the data had not been reviewed.
The drug was approved slowly since the committee examined the data with great care.
The committee reviewed the data carefully, so it approved the drug without hesitation.
q.e: Üçüncü tip koşul (had + V3): gerçekte veri yeterince incelenmedi ve ilaç hızlı onaylandı. Diğerleri gerçeği tersine çeviriyor veya zamanı kaydırıyor.

q.q: Rarely do economists agree on the long-term effects of tax cuts on growth.
o: Economists have recently begun to agree about the growth effects of tax cuts.
Economists almost always agree that tax cuts harm long-term growth.
Economists seldom share a common view about how tax cuts affect growth in the long run.
Economists rarely study the long-term effects of tax cuts on growth.
Tax cuts rarely have any long-term effect on economic growth according to economists.
q.e: Rarely do = seldom; fikir birliği nadir. Diğerleri uzlaşıyı ima ediyor veya etkinin yokluğunu/çalışılmadığını söylüyor.

q.q: Not until the 19th century did scientists understand that many diseases are caused by microorganisms.
o: Scientists understood the role of microorganisms in disease long before the 19th century.
In the 19th century scientists denied that microorganisms could cause diseases.
Only a few scientists in the 19th century studied diseases caused by microorganisms.
Many diseases disappeared in the 19th century once microorganisms were understood.
Scientists only realised in the 19th century that microorganisms cause many diseases.
q.e: Not until = ancak ... -dan sonra. Doğru şık zamanı korur; diğerleri zamanı öne alır, olguyu inkâr eder veya yeni bilgi ekler.

q.q: The museum's director, however reluctant, agreed to lend the painting to the exhibition.
o: The director agreed to lend the painting only because the exhibition was reluctant to accept it.
The painting was lent to the exhibition without the director's knowledge.
The museum's director refused to lend the painting because she was reluctant.
Although the museum's director was unwilling, she agreed to lend the painting to the exhibition.
The museum's director was eager to lend the painting to the exhibition.
q.e: however reluctant = although unwilling (tezat). Diğerleri reddetme, istekli olma veya gerçek dışı neden ekliyor.

q.q: Few of the participants in the study reported any improvement in their sleep quality.
o: Most participants in the study said their sleep quality had improved.
Hardly any participants in the study said their sleep quality had got better.
Few participants took part in the study on sleep quality.
Some participants reported that their sleep quality had become worse.
Every participant reported a slight improvement in sleep quality.
q.e: Few of ... any improvement = hardly any ... got better. Diğerleri çoğunluğu, kötüleşmeyi, katılımcı sayısını veya herkesi vurguluyor.

q.q: Unless governments invest in renewable energy, carbon emissions will continue to rise.
o: Even if governments invest in renewable energy, carbon emissions will rise.
Governments will invest in renewable energy once carbon emissions rise.
If governments do not invest in renewable energy, carbon emissions will keep increasing.
Carbon emissions will fall whether or not governments invest in renewable energy.
Carbon emissions will rise only if governments invest in renewable energy.
q.e: Unless = if ... not. Diğerleri koşulu tersine çeviriyor veya nedensellik kuruyor.

q.q: The survey results were not as encouraging as the researchers had hoped.
o: The researchers had expected more encouraging survey results than they actually got.
The survey results were exactly what the researchers had hoped for.
The researchers hoped to conduct the survey again with more encouraging results.
The survey results were more encouraging than the researchers had hoped.
The researchers were not interested in whether the results were encouraging.
q.e: not as ... as = beklenenden daha az cesaret verici. Diğerleri beklentiyi aşıyor, karşılıyor veya konuyu değiştiriyor.

q.q: It is thought that the ancient city was abandoned following a prolonged drought.
o: It is thought that the ancient city was abandoned before a prolonged drought began.
It is thought that the ancient city will be abandoned if a drought lasts long.
People believe that a prolonged drought was caused by the abandonment of the ancient city.
The ancient city is known to have been destroyed by invaders during a drought.
The ancient city is believed to have been deserted after a long period without rain.
q.e: abandoned = deserted; drought = long period without rain; following = after. Diğerlerinde neden-sonuç, neden veya zaman değişiyor.

q.q: Nobody could have predicted how quickly the glacier would retreat.
o: The glacier did not retreat as quickly as it could have.
The glacier retreated more slowly than anybody had predicted.
Everybody predicted that the glacier would retreat quickly.
Nobody was interested in predicting the glacier's retreat.
The speed at which the glacier retreated was impossible to foresee.
q.e: Nobody could have predicted = impossible to foresee. Diğerleri tahmini olumluya çeviriyor veya hız karşılaştırması uyduruyor.

q.q: The more sedentary people become, the greater their risk of developing chronic illness.
o: People who develop chronic illness become more sedentary as a result.
Chronic illness is equally likely whether or not people are active.
Sedentary people are at risk of chronic illness only if they become older.
As people get less physically active, they are more likely to suffer from long-term illness.
The greater people's risk of chronic illness, the less sedentary they become.
q.e: The more..., the greater... = paralel artış. Diğerleri nedenselliği ters çeviriyor veya ilişkiyi reddediyor.

q.q: Despite having been widely criticised, the policy remained in force for over a decade.
o: The policy was withdrawn after a decade of widespread criticism.
The policy stayed in effect for more than ten years even though many people criticised it.
The policy was widely criticised because it remained in force for over a decade.
Few people criticised the policy during the decade it was in force.
The policy would have remained in force for a decade had it not been criticised.
q.e: Despite = even though. Diğerleri neden-sonucu ters çeviriyor, politikayı kaldırıyor veya eleştiriyi azaltıyor.

q.q: She would rather have studied linguistics than economics, but her parents insisted otherwise.
o: She preferred linguistics to economics, yet she ended up studying what her parents wanted.
She was unable to choose between linguistics and economics.
Her parents studied economics, so she chose linguistics.
She enjoyed economics more than linguistics, as her parents had hoped.
She studied linguistics because her parents insisted on it.
q.e: would rather have + V3 = geçmişte yapmadığı tercih; ailesi başka yönde ısrar etti. Diğerleri tercihi veya gerçeği çarpıtıyor.

q.q: Only by combining several methods can researchers obtain reliable estimates of population size.
o: Researchers rarely need to estimate population size reliably.
Researchers can obtain reliable estimates using any single method.
Combining several methods always makes population estimates less reliable.
Population size can be estimated reliably only by a single, well-tested method.
Reliable population estimates require researchers to use more than one method together.
q.e: Only by combining = gereklilik koşulu. Diğerleri tek yöntemi yeterli sayıyor veya birleştirmeyi olumsuzluyor.

q.q: The new battery, which lasts twice as long as its predecessor, costs a third more.
o: The new battery is as long-lasting and as expensive as the earlier one.
The new battery costs a third less but lasts half as long as the old one.
The earlier battery lasted twice as long as the new one but cost more.
Compared with the earlier battery, the new one has double the lifespan but a higher price.
The new battery lasts a third longer and costs twice as much as its predecessor.
q.e: twice as long = double the lifespan; costs a third more = higher price. Diğerlerinde oranlar veya karşılaştırma yönü değişiyor.

q.q: Were it not for volunteers, many rural clinics would have to close.
o: Volunteers prefer to work in rural clinics that are about to close.
Volunteers are not allowed to work in rural clinics.
Many rural clinics depend on volunteers to stay open.
Rural clinics would stay open even without any volunteers.
Many rural clinics have already closed because volunteers left.
q.e: Were it not for = olmasaydı; klinikler gönüllülere bağımlı. Diğerleri bağımlılığı yok sayıyor veya olmayan olgular ekliyor.

q.q: The author takes it for granted that readers are familiar with basic statistics.
o: The author explains basic statistics so readers can follow the argument.
The author doubts that readers have studied basic statistics.
The author is grateful that readers are interested in basic statistics.
The author believes basic statistics should be taught to every reader.
The author assumes without question that readers already know elementary statistics.
q.e: take it for granted = varsaymak. Diğerleri minnettarlık, açıklama, şüphe veya öneri ekliyor.

q.q: No sooner had the company announced its profits than its share price began to fall.
o: The company's share price started to drop immediately after its profits were announced.
The company's share price rose as soon as profits were announced.
The company's share price had fallen before its profits were announced.
The company announced its profits because its share price began to fall.
The company announced profits only after its share price had stopped falling.
q.e: No sooner... than = hemen ardından. Diğerleri sırayı, nedeni veya yönü değiştiriyor.

q.q: Much as he admired his mentor, he could not accept her interpretation of the evidence.
o: He respected his mentor greatly, but he disagreed with how she read the evidence.
He admired his mentor because she accepted his interpretation of the evidence.
He was unable to admire his mentor as he disliked her interpretation.
He could not understand his mentor's interpretation of the evidence at all.
He accepted his mentor's interpretation since he admired her so much.
q.e: Much as = although very much. Hayranlık var ama yorum reddediliyor. Diğerleri tezadı kaldırıyor veya hayranlığı yok ediyor.

q.q: Contrary to popular belief, bats are not blind.
o: Bats are blind, but few people know this.
Bats are not blind only in popular stories.
Popular belief holds that bats can see better than other animals.
Bats can see, although many people think they cannot.
Many people believe bats are blind, and this is true.
q.e: Contrary to popular belief = yaygın kanının aksine; yarasalar görebilir. Diğerleri kanıyı doğruluyor veya çarpıtıyor.

q.q: The government is said to be considering raising the retirement age.
o: The government has announced that it has raised the retirement age.
The government is considering lowering the retirement age, it is said.
People say the government has already abolished the retirement age.
According to reports, the government is thinking about increasing the retirement age.
The government is reported to have rejected an increase in the retirement age.
q.e: is said to be considering = rivayete göre düşünüyor. Diğerleri kararı kesinleştiriyor, reddediyor veya yönü değiştiriyor.

q.q: Her findings, though preliminary, suggest that early bilingualism may protect against cognitive decline.
o: Her findings show that bilingual people suffer more cognitive decline.
Her early results hint that learning two languages young could help prevent mental decline.
Her preliminary study found no link between bilingualism and cognitive decline.
Her final results prove that early bilingualism prevents cognitive decline.
Her findings suggest cognitive decline makes people bilingual early on.
q.e: suggest/may = ihtiyatlı ifade. Diğerleri kesinlik, ters etki, ilişkisizlik veya ters nedensellik ekliyor.

q.q: There is little point in expanding the airport unless public transport links are improved.
o: There is no need to improve public transport if the airport is not expanded.
Enlarging the airport will be of limited value if public transport connections stay as they are.
The airport should be expanded even though public transport links are poor.
Public transport links will improve as soon as the airport is expanded.
Improving public transport links is pointless unless the airport is expanded.
q.e: unless = if not; little point = limited value. Diğerleri koşulu ters çeviriyor veya gereksiz öneri ekliyor.

q.q: The drought affected not only crop yields but also the price of livestock.
o: Both crop yields and livestock prices were influenced by the drought.
The drought affected crop yields, but livestock prices were unaffected.
Neither crop yields nor livestock prices were influenced by the drought.
Livestock prices rose because crop yields were not affected by the drought.
The drought was caused by falling crop yields and rising livestock prices.
q.e: not only... but also = both... and. Diğerleri bir etkiyi yok sayıyor veya nedenselliği bozuyor.

q.q: It was not until she moved abroad that she realised how much she depended on her family.
o: Moving abroad made her less dependent on her family than before.
She had always known how much she depended on her family before moving abroad.
She realised she depended on her family, so she never moved abroad.
Living in another country made her aware for the first time of her reliance on her family.
She moved abroad because she realised she depended too much on her family.
q.e: not until = ancak ... sonra fark etti. Diğerleri sırayı ters çeviriyor veya yeni sonuçlar uyduruyor.

q.q: The theory has been challenged repeatedly, yet it continues to shape research in the field.
o: The theory shapes research in the field because it has never been challenged.
Because it has been challenged, the theory no longer influences research in the field.
Despite frequent challenges, the theory still influences work in the discipline.
Researchers have repeatedly challenged the field instead of the theory.
The theory has shaped the field only since it was first challenged.
q.e: yet = despite. Diğerleri etkiyi yok ediyor, meydan okumayı reddediyor veya hedefi/zamanı kaydırıyor.

q.q: Hardly had the lecture begun when the projector broke down.
o: The lecture began after the projector had been repaired.
The lecture had nearly finished when the projector broke down.
The projector broke down because the lecture lasted too long.
The lecture was cancelled before the projector could break down.
The projector stopped working almost as soon as the lecture started.
q.e: Hardly... when = neredeyse hemen. Diğerleri zamanı, nedeni veya olayı değiştiriyor.

q.q: Inflation, if left unchecked, tends to erode the purchasing power of fixed incomes.
o: Inflation only affects those whose incomes change frequently.
Fixed incomes tend to cause inflation when left unchecked.
When inflation is not controlled, people on fixed incomes can buy less over time.
Controlling inflation reduces the purchasing power of people on fixed incomes.
People with fixed incomes gain purchasing power as inflation rises.
q.e: erode purchasing power = daha az satın alabilmek. Diğerleri nedenselliği veya etki yönünü ters çeviriyor.

q.q: The experiment would have succeeded had the temperature been kept constant.
o: The experiment succeeded although the temperature was not kept constant.
The experiment will succeed if the temperature is kept constant.
The experiment failed even though the temperature was kept constant.
The experiment succeeded because the temperature was kept constant.
The experiment failed because the temperature was not kept constant.
q.e: Üçüncü tip koşul: gerçekte sıcaklık sabit tutulmadı ve deney başarısız oldu. Diğerleri gerçeği olumluya çeviriyor veya zamanı kaydırıyor.

q.q: Whatever the reasons for the decline in bee populations, urgent action is needed.
o: Action can wait until the reasons for the bee decline are identified.
Nobody knows whether urgent action is needed to stop the decline in bees.
Bee populations are declining because urgent action has not been taken.
Regardless of what has caused fewer bees, immediate measures are necessary.
Urgent action is needed only if the reasons for the decline are known.
q.e: Whatever = regardless of. Nedenden bağımsız acil eylem. Diğerleri eylemi nedene bağlıyor veya erteliyor.

q.q: Few discoveries have had as great an impact on modern medicine as antibiotics.
o: Modern medicine has had a great impact on the discovery of antibiotics.
Antibiotics have influenced modern medicine more than almost any other discovery.
Antibiotics have had less impact on modern medicine than most discoveries.
Several discoveries have affected modern medicine more strongly than antibiotics.
Few discoveries in modern medicine have been as harmful as antibiotics.
q.e: Few ... as great as = neredeyse hepsinden daha etkili. Diğerleri etkiyi azaltıyor, yönü ters çeviriyor veya anlamı değiştiriyor.

q.q: Sleep is often treated as a luxury in modern societies. Yet research shows that adults who regularly sleep fewer than six hours are more likely to develop heart disease. ---- Consequently, many health agencies now recommend that people treat sleep as seriously as diet and exercise.
o: Heart disease was first described by doctors in the nineteenth century.
Lack of rest also weakens the immune system and makes it harder to concentrate during the day.
Luxury goods are more popular in modern societies than ever before.
Diet and exercise have no connection with how long people sleep.
Most people who sleep eight hours a day work in offices.
q.e: Sağlık zararlarını sayan paragrafa 'also' ile ek zarar ekleyen cümle uyar; Consequently ile bağlanan öneriyle tutarlı.

q.q: Cities are usually several degrees warmer than the surrounding countryside. ---- Dark roads and roofs absorb sunlight and release it slowly after sunset. As a result, planners are experimenting with reflective materials and additional green spaces.
o: Cities have become cooler as the number of residents has fallen.
Countryside areas are warmer than cities because they contain more concrete.
This 'urban heat island' effect arises largely from the materials from which cities are built.
Planners have no interest in the temperature of cities.
Sunlight never reaches the ground in densely built areas.
q.e: Sonraki cümle malzemelerin ısıyı tuttuğunu anlatır; boşluk bu etkinin nedenini tanıtmalı. Diğerleri bilgiyle çelişir.

q.q: The invention of the printing press transformed European society. Books, once copied by hand, could now be produced quickly and cheaply. ---- Literacy rates rose steadily, and new ideas spread across borders faster than ever before.
o: Handwritten manuscripts became more valuable than they had ever been before.
Information therefore became accessible to far more people than the clergy and nobility alone.
Literacy was already universal in Europe before the press was invented.
Printers refused to publish works on science or religion.
The cost of paper made books too expensive for ordinary readers.
q.e: Ucuz kitap, geniş erişim ve okuryazarlık artışı arasında mantıksal köprü kurar. Diğerleri paragrafla çelişir.

q.q: Microplastics have been found in oceans, rivers and even in remote mountain snow. ---- Scientists are still unsure how these particles affect human health. Nevertheless, many researchers argue that reducing plastic production is the only reliable way to limit exposure.
o: Remote mountains are the only places where plastics cannot be found.
Large pieces of plastic are easy to remove from the sea and therefore pose no danger.
Fish avoid plastic particles because they can detect them easily.
Because they are so small, they enter the food chain easily and are consumed by fish and humans alike.
Their effects on human health have been fully understood for decades.
q.e: Yaygınlık ve insan sağlığı kaygısı arasındaki bağlantıyı (besin zinciri) kurar. Diğerleri 'unsure' ve ilk cümleyle çelişir.

q.q: A placebo is a treatment with no active ingredient, such as a sugar pill. ---- Patients given placebos often report genuine relief from pain, even when they know what they are taking. This suggests that expectation plays a powerful role in how the body responds to treatment.
o: Surprisingly, it can still produce measurable improvements in a patient's condition.
Doctors prescribe placebos only to patients who are not really ill.
Placebos have been shown to cure serious infections in every case.
It is more expensive to manufacture than ordinary medicine.
Patients who take placebos always experience harmful side effects.
q.e: Etkin madde olmamasına rağmen iyileşme olduğunu belirtir; sonraki cümle bunu destekler.

q.q: Remote work has become common in many industries. Employees often value the flexibility and the time saved by not commuting. ---- Some managers, on the other hand, worry that teams lose cohesion when colleagues rarely meet in person.
o: Commuting has become faster because fewer people use public transport.
Flexibility is the least important factor for most employees.
Companies that allow remote work have all gone out of business.
Studies indicate that many workers are at least as productive at home as in the office.
Managers prefer that employees never meet in person.
q.e: 'On the other hand' öncesinde olumlu bir görüş gerekir; verimlilik bulgusu bunu sağlar.

q.q: The Industrial Revolution began in Britain in the late eighteenth century. ---- Factories replaced small workshops, and workers moved from villages to rapidly growing towns. Although output soared, living conditions for the poor were often dreadful.
o: Steam engines were abandoned because they were too weak to drive machinery.
Britain was at that time a country with almost no industry.
New machines, powered first by water and then by steam, changed the way goods were made.
Most workers remained in the countryside throughout the period.
Living conditions improved dramatically for all members of society.
q.e: Fabrikaların atölyelerin yerini alması makineleşmeyi gerektirir; boşluk bunu tanıtır.

q.q: Coral reefs cover less than one per cent of the ocean floor. ---- When water temperatures rise, corals expel the algae that give them colour and food, a process called bleaching. Unless the warming slows, large areas of reef may die within decades.
o: They are found mostly in cold polar waters, where bleaching is rare.
Because they are so small, scientists have rarely studied them.
They cover most of the ocean floor and are therefore unaffected by local changes.
Bleaching is a beneficial process that helps corals grow faster.
Yet they support about a quarter of all marine species and are very sensitive to temperature.
q.e: Küçük alan ile büyük önem arasındaki tezat ve ısıya duyarlılık sonraki cümleye bağlanır.

q.q: Psychologists distinguish between short-term and long-term memory. Short-term memory can hold only a handful of items at once. ---- This is why information that is rehearsed or linked to existing knowledge is far more likely to be remembered.
o: Memory is unrelated to what a person already knows.
Unless such items are transferred to long-term storage, they fade within seconds.
Items in short-term memory are stored permanently without effort.
Psychologists have shown that rehearsal makes memory worse.
Long-term memory can retain only a handful of items at a time.
q.e: Tekrarın önemini açıklayan neden: uzun süreli belleğe aktarılmazsa unutulur.

q.q: Microfinance programmes offer small loans to people who lack access to conventional banks. Supporters argue that such loans help poor entrepreneurs start businesses. ---- For example, some borrowers take on new debt to repay old loans, which deepens their difficulties.
o: Entrepreneurs do not need money to start a business.
Critics, however, point out that the benefits are not always as large as promised.
All evidence shows that microloans end poverty in every region.
Banks have always been eager to lend large sums to the poor.
Supporters have therefore stopped promoting such loans entirely.
q.e: Destekçilerden sonra eleştirmenlere geçiş; 'For example' borçlanma sorununu örnekler.

q.q: Antibiotics have saved millions of lives since their discovery. ---- Bacteria exposed to these drugs repeatedly can evolve defences against them. In response, doctors are urged to prescribe antibiotics only when they are truly necessary.
o: Doctors prefer to prescribe them for every minor illness.
They were abandoned soon after their discovery as ineffective.
Their overuse, however, has created a serious new problem.
Viruses are the only organisms that ever develop resistance.
Bacteria have never been able to survive contact with them.
q.e: Olumlu girişten sonra 'however' ile aşırı kullanım sorununa geçer; direnç gelişimi bunu açıklar.

q.q: The Silk Road was not a single road but a network of trade routes linking China with the Mediterranean. Merchants rarely travelled its entire length. ---- Along the way, goods, religions and technologies were exchanged between very different cultures.
o: The routes were controlled by a single empire from start to finish.
Instead, goods were usually passed from trader to trader across many separate stages.
Silk was the only product ever sold along these routes.
Most merchants travelled from China to the Mediterranean in a single journey.
Different cultures avoided contact with one another.
q.e: 'rarely travelled entire length' ifadesinin devamı: 'Instead' ile kademeli ticaret.

q.q: Nuclear power produces large amounts of electricity without emitting carbon dioxide during operation. ---- Building a plant, however, takes many years and requires enormous investment. Moreover, the safe storage of radioactive waste remains an unresolved political issue.
o: Electricity can only be produced from nuclear fuel.
For this reason, some governments regard it as a useful tool against climate change.
Radioactive waste is harmless and needs no storage.
Nuclear plants emit more carbon dioxide than coal plants do.
No government has ever considered using nuclear power.
q.e: Karbonsuz üretimin sonucu; 'however' ile gelen dezavantajlarla tezat oluşturur.

q.q: Children acquire their first language with remarkable ease. ---- Adults learning a second language, by contrast, usually need years of effort and often retain a noticeable accent. Some linguists therefore believe that there is a critical period for language learning.
o: Adults usually learn languages faster than children do.
Without formal instruction, most infants master the basic grammar of their language by the age of five.
Children need years of formal lessons to learn their first language.
Accents disappear in adults after a few weeks of study.
Only children who attend school can speak fluently by age five.
q.e: 'by contrast' çocukların kolaylığını gösteren bir ifade gerektirir.

q.q: More than half of the world's population now lives in cities. ---- Housing shortages, traffic congestion and pollution have become pressing problems in many of them. Even so, cities also offer better access to jobs, schools and hospitals.
o: Rural areas now suffer from severe traffic congestion.
This rapid urbanisation has put enormous pressure on infrastructure and public services.
Cities in most countries have been shrinking for decades.
Few people consider moving to a city for work.
Pollution is almost unknown in large urban centres.
q.e: Şehirleşmeyi sonraki cümledeki sorunlara bağlayan sebep-sonuç cümlesi.

q.q: Charles Darwin spent years collecting evidence before he published his theory of evolution. ---- Birds, plants and fossils he examined on his voyage convinced him that species change over time. Even so, he hesitated for two decades, fearing the reaction of the public.
o: He rejected the idea of change in species until he was an old man.
He wrote his theory before he had ever left England.
His journey aboard HMS Beagle gave him an unrivalled opportunity to observe nature.
Nobody in the public paid any attention to natural history.
His voyage lasted only a few days and produced little data.
q.e: 'his voyage' ifadesi öncesinde yolculuğun tanıtılmasını gerektirir.

q.q: The gig economy allows people to earn money by taking short-term jobs through digital platforms. Many workers enjoy choosing their own hours. ---- Because they are classified as independent contractors, they often lack paid holidays, sick pay and pensions.
o: Independent contractors always receive better benefits than employees.
Short-term jobs have completely replaced permanent employment.
On the other hand, this freedom often comes at the cost of job security.
Digital platforms have no influence on how people find work.
As a result, gig workers are guaranteed stable incomes throughout the year.
q.e: Esnekliğin olumlu yönünden sonra olumsuz yöne geçiş; sonraki cümle güvence eksikliğini açıklar.

q.q: When a large proportion of a population is vaccinated, a disease finds it difficult to spread. ---- This protection, known as herd immunity, shields even those who cannot be vaccinated, such as newborn babies. If vaccination rates fall, outbreaks can quickly return.
o: Outbreaks occur only in countries with high vaccination rates.
Vaccinated people are always more likely to catch the disease.
The few infected individuals rarely meet anyone who is still vulnerable to the illness.
Newborn babies are the group most likely to spread the disease.
Diseases spread more easily when more people are protected.
q.e: Bulaşmanın zorlaşma nedenini açıklar ve sürü bağışıklığına götürür.

q.q: Automation has changed manufacturing profoundly. Machines now perform tasks that once required hundreds of workers. ---- Economists disagree about whether new technologies will create as many jobs as they eliminate.
o: Economists agree that automation never affects employment.
Machines have proved too expensive for any company to buy.
Hundreds of workers are needed to operate a single machine.
Therefore, factories now employ more unskilled workers than ever before.
Consequently, many routine jobs have disappeared, while demand for technical skills has grown.
q.e: Makinelerin işçilerin yerini alması sonucu; ekonomistlerin istihdam tartışmasına köprü.

q.q: The Mediterranean diet is rich in vegetables, olive oil and fish. ---- In one large trial, participants who followed it had markedly fewer heart attacks than those on a low-fat diet. Researchers suspect that the combination of nutrients, rather than any single food, explains the benefit.
o: The diet is popular mainly because it is cheaper than other diets.
No study has ever examined the effects of this diet on health.
A growing body of evidence links this style of eating to better cardiovascular health.
Participants on a low-fat diet had the fewest heart attacks.
Red meat and butter are its most important ingredients.
q.e: Sonraki cümlede kanıt (deney) sunulur; boşluk genel iddiayı kurar.

q.q: The Roman Empire built an extensive network of paved roads. ---- Soldiers could march quickly to troubled provinces, and officials could send messages across thousands of kilometres. The roads also encouraged trade, which tied distant regions together economically.
o: These routes were originally designed to serve military and administrative needs.
The army avoided using them because they were too narrow.
They were built mainly to attract tourists from neighbouring countries.
Trade was discouraged because travel between regions was forbidden.
Few of them lasted longer than a single year.
q.e: 'also encouraged trade' ifadesi önceki amacın askeri/idari olduğunu gerektirir.

q.q: Many people check their phones dozens of times a day. ---- A recent experiment found that students whose phones were in another room performed better on memory tests than those whose phones were merely on the desk. The mere presence of the device, it seems, draws attention away from the task at hand.
o: Researchers have begun to investigate whether this habit affects our ability to concentrate.
Students who left their phones at home always failed their tests.
The experiment showed that memory is unaffected by distractions.
Phones have been proved to improve concentration in every circumstance.
Checking the phone is considered a sign of excellent memory.
q.e: Genel alışkanlıktan deneye geçiş için araştırma konusunu tanıtır.

q.q: Solar and wind power are growing rapidly, but they have a significant drawback. ---- The sun does not always shine and the wind does not always blow. Better batteries and smarter grids are therefore seen as essential for a renewable future.
o: Batteries are no longer needed because supply is constant.
Their output varies with the weather, which makes supply difficult to predict.
They produce more electricity at night than during the day.
They are far more polluting than coal-fired power stations.
They cannot be used anywhere outside desert regions.
q.e: 'drawback' kavramını açıklar; sonraki cümle bu değişkenliği örnekler.

q.q: For centuries, nobody could read Egyptian hieroglyphs. ---- It carried the same decree in three scripts, one of which was ancient Greek. By comparing the texts, the scholar Jean-Francois Champollion finally deciphered the hieroglyphs in the 1820s.
o: Egyptian hieroglyphs were widely taught in European schools.
The discovery of the Rosetta Stone in 1799 offered the key that had long been missing.
Champollion discovered the stone only after deciphering the hieroglyphs.
The Rosetta Stone was written entirely in a language nobody knew.
Ancient Greek was unknown to scholars in the nineteenth century.
q.e: 'It' ifadesi taşı işaret eder; boşlukta taş tanıtılmalıdır.

q.q: Education is widely seen as a route to a better life. ---- Children from wealthy families tend to attend better-funded schools and receive extra tutoring. Unless governments address these gaps, schooling may reinforce social divisions instead of reducing them.
o: Education has been proved to be of no value to anyone.
Consequently, all children now enjoy exactly the same educational chances.
Wealthy families rarely care about the quality of their children's schools.
In practice, however, opportunities are not equally distributed among all pupils.
Governments have already eliminated differences between schools.
q.e: Genel görüşle çelişen 'however' cümlesi; sonraki cümle eşitsizliği örnekler.

q.q: Honeybees communicate through a remarkable 'waggle dance'. A forager that has found a rich source of nectar returns to the hive and moves in a figure-of-eight pattern. ---- The duration of the waggle tells the other bees how far they must fly.
o: The angle of the dance relative to vertical indicates the direction of the food in relation to the sun.
The dance is performed outside the hive in complete silence.
The bees use the dance only to show that they are tired.
Other bees ignore the dance and search at random.
Bees perform it only at night to avoid predators.
q.e: Son cümle mesafeyi anlatır; boşluk yönü anlatarak bilgiyi tamamlar.

q.q: A small amount of stress can improve performance by sharpening focus. ---- Prolonged stress, however, keeps stress hormones elevated, which can damage the heart and weaken the immune system. Learning to relax is therefore not a luxury but a health necessity.
o: Stress hormones are completely absent from the human body.
Prolonged stress is beneficial for the heart in most people.
Before an important exam, for instance, mild anxiety may help students prepare more thoroughly.
Students perform best when they feel no concern whatever.
Relaxation has been shown to damage the immune system.
q.e: Hafif stresin yararını örnekleyen cümle; 'however' ile uzun süreli stres zıtlığı kurulur.

q.q: In 1965 Gordon Moore observed that the number of transistors on a chip doubled roughly every two years. ---- Computers became smaller, faster and cheaper at a pace unmatched by almost any other technology. Today, however, engineers are approaching physical limits to how small components can be made.
o: Moore stated that chips would stop improving after two years.
Computers became larger and more expensive during this period.
The number of transistors on chips has actually decreased since then.
This pattern, later called Moore's law, held true for several decades.
Engineers have never faced any limits in designing chips.
q.e: Gözlemin adlandırılması ve süresi; 'Today, however' ile geçmiş-bugün zıtlığı kurulur.

q.q: Many bird species migrate thousands of kilometres each year. ---- Some navigate by the position of the sun and stars, while others appear to sense the Earth's magnetic field. Climate change is now disrupting these ancient routines.
o: Magnetic fields do not exist on Earth.
Biologists have concluded that migration is purely accidental.
How they find their way across unfamiliar terrain has long fascinated biologists.
Birds fly the same distances regardless of the season.
Birds that migrate never leave the area where they were hatched.
q.e: Sonraki cümle yön bulma yöntemlerini sayar; boşluk bu soruyu tanıtır.

q.q: Tourism brings money to many struggling regions. ---- In popular destinations such as Venice, residents complain about overcrowding, rising rents and damage to historic sites. Several cities have therefore introduced entry fees or limits on visitor numbers.
o: No region has ever benefited financially from tourism.
Yet an excess of visitors can harm the very places that attract them.
Hence, popular destinations are always happy to receive more tourists.
Entry fees have been shown to increase overcrowding.
Residents of Venice have recently asked for more visitors to arrive.
q.e: Olumlu girişe 'Yet' ile karşıt, sonraki sorunlarla uyumlu cümle.

q.q: The Great Depression began with the stock market crash of 1929. Banks failed, factories closed and unemployment soared. ---- It was not until government spending increased dramatically during the Second World War that the American economy fully recovered.
o: Despite various relief programmes, recovery in the 1930s was slow and uneven.
Unemployment fell steadily from the moment the crash occurred.
By 1931 the economy had already returned to full employment.
The crash had no noticeable effect on the banking system.
Government spending was cut sharply during the Second World War.
q.e: Tam toparlanmanın ancak savaşta gerçekleştiği bilgisiyle tutarlı: 1930'larda yavaş iyileşme.

q.q: The human intestine is home to trillions of bacteria, collectively known as the microbiome. ---- They help digest food, produce vitamins and train the immune system. Some studies even suggest a link between gut bacteria and mood, though this research is still at an early stage.
o: Research on gut bacteria and mood is already complete.
The microbiome has no effect on digestion or the immune system.
Far from being harmful invaders, most of these organisms are beneficial to their host.
Bacteria in the intestine can survive only outside the human body.
All intestinal bacteria cause disease and should be eliminated.
q.e: 'They help...' cümlesi yararlı rolü sıralar; boşluk bakterilerin faydalı olduğunu belirtir.

cloze.title: Sleep and Learning
cloze.p: Sleep is essential for learning. During sleep, the brain processes the information it (1)---- during the day. Studies show that students who sleep well remember more, (2)---- those who stay up late to study often perform worse. This is because the brain needs time (3)---- new memories. Lack of sleep also affects mood, (4)---- makes it harder to concentrate. Experts therefore recommend at least seven hours of sleep a night, (5)---- before an important exam.

qs.e: Gün boyunca aldığı bilgi, uykudan önce tamamlanmış bir eylem; geniş zamanlı ana cümlede present perfect (has received) uygun.
İyi uyuyanlar ile geç saate kadar çalışanlar karşılaştırılıyor: zıtlık bağlacı whereas.
"Need time to do" kalıbı: zaman gerekir + to + fiil.
Virgülden sonra önceki cümlenin tamamını niteleyen which gelir; that virgülden sonra kullanılmaz.
Özellikle önemli bir sınavdan önce: especially.

cloze.title: The Rise of Electric Cars
cloze.p: Electric cars are becoming more popular around the world. In 2015, they made up less than one per cent of new car sales, but this figure (1)---- to more than fifteen per cent today. One reason is that batteries have become cheaper and more (2)----. In addition, many governments offer tax incentives (3)---- encourage people to buy them. (4)----, some problems remain. Charging stations are still rare in rural areas, and the production of batteries requires large amounts of energy. Nevertheless, most experts believe that electric cars will (5)---- replace petrol cars in the coming decades.

qs.e: Geçmişten bugüne (today) uzanan bir değişim: present perfect (has risen).
"More + sıfat" yapısı ve olumlu anlam: efficient (verimli). Cheaper ile paralel bir sıfat gerekir.
Amaç bildiren ve yalın fiil alan yapı: in order to encourage. So that'ten sonra özne + fiil gelir.
Önceki olumlu bilgilere zıt olarak sorunlar geliyor: However.
Gelecekte sonunda yerini alacak: eventually (nihayetinde).

cloze.title: Bilingual Children
cloze.p: Children who grow up speaking two languages enjoy several advantages. Research suggests that bilingual children are often better at (1)---- attention and switching between tasks. This may be because they constantly have to choose (2)---- language to use. Some parents worry that learning two languages at the same time might confuse young children. (3)----, there is little evidence to support this fear. Although bilingual children sometimes start speaking slightly later, they usually (4)---- up with their peers by the age of five. Experts therefore encourage parents (5)---- both languages at home.

qs.e: "Be good at" kalıbında at bir edattır; edattan sonra fiil -ing alır.
İki dil arasından seçim: "hangi dili kullanacakları" = which language.
Ebeveynlerin endişesine karşın kanıt yok: zıtlık bağlacı However.
"Catch up with" = yetişmek, arayı kapatmak. Akranlarına beş yaşına kadar yetişirler.
"Encourage someone to do" kalıbı: to + fiil.

cloze.title: Coral Reefs
cloze.p: Coral reefs cover less than one per cent of the ocean floor, (1)---- they are home to about a quarter of all marine species. Unfortunately, they are in serious danger. Rising sea temperatures cause corals to lose the tiny algae (2)---- live inside them and give them their colour. This process, (3)---- as coral bleaching, can kill entire reefs if it continues for too long. Pollution and overfishing (4)---- the problem even worse. Scientists warn that unless urgent action is taken, most of the world's reefs could disappear (5)---- the end of this century.

qs.e: Okyanus tabanının çok küçük bir kısmını kaplıyorlar ama türlerin dörtte birine ev sahipliği yapıyorlar: zıtlık bağlacı yet (ama).
Algae (canlılar) için özne konumunda ilgi zamiri: that (ya da which). What burada kullanılamaz.
"Known as" = olarak bilinen. Kısaltılmış edilgen ilgi cümleciği (which is known as).
"Make something worse" = bir şeyi daha kötü hale getirmek.
"By the end of this century" = bu yüzyılın sonuna kadar (bir son nokta).

cloze.title: Fast Food
cloze.p: Fast food has become part of daily life for millions of people. It is cheap, quick and easy (1)---- find. However, doctors warn that eating it too often can lead (2)---- serious health problems, such as obesity and heart disease. Most fast food is high in salt, sugar and fat, (3)---- it contains few vitamins. (4)---- the risks, the industry continues to grow, especially in developing countries. Experts suggest that schools should teach children about healthy eating (5)---- they can make better choices.

qs.e: "Easy to find" = bulması kolay. Sıfat + to + fiil yapısı.
"Lead to" = yol açmak.
Yüksek tuz, şeker ve yağa karşın az vitamin: iki durumu karşılaştıran while.
Risklere rağmen ve arkasından isim (the risks) geliyor: Despite. Although'dan sonra cümle gelir.
Amaç ve arkasından özne + fiil (they can make): so that.

cloze.title: The Silk Road
cloze.p: The Silk Road was not a single road but a network of trade routes (1)---- connected China with the Mediterranean. For more than a thousand years, merchants carried silk, spices and other goods (2)---- these routes. However, trade was not the only thing that travelled along them. Ideas, religions and technologies also (3)---- from one culture to another. Paper, for instance, (4)---- in China and later reached Europe through the Silk Road. (5)----, the routes played a key role in shaping the modern world.

qs.e: Routes (yollar) için özne konumunda ilgi zamiri: that.
"Along these routes" = bu yollar boyunca.
Geçmişte olan bir olay; spread düzensiz fiildir ve geçmiş hâli de spread'dir.
Kâğıt kendisi icat etmez, icat edilir: edilgen ve geçmiş (was invented).
Önceki bilgilerin vardığı sonuç: Therefore (bu nedenle).

cloze.title: Volunteering
cloze.p: Volunteering means giving your time to help others without (1)---- paid. Many people volunteer at hospitals, schools or animal shelters. Research shows that volunteering benefits not only the people who receive help (2)---- the volunteers themselves. People who volunteer regularly report (3)---- levels of stress and a greater sense of purpose. Some studies have even found that older volunteers live longer than those who do not volunteer. (4)----, it is important to choose an activity you enjoy; (5)----, you may soon lose interest.

qs.e: "Without" bir edattır; ardından -ing gelir. Edilgen anlam (ücret almadan) için being paid.
"Not only … but also" ikili bağlacı.
"Levels" ile birlikte daha düşük seviye: lower levels of stress.
Faydalar anlatıldıktan sonra bir uyarı geliyor: However.
"Sevdiğin bir etkinlik seç; aksi halde ilgini kaybedebilirsin": otherwise.

cloze.title: Earthquakes
cloze.p: Earthquakes happen when large pieces of the Earth's crust suddenly move. Most of them occur along the boundaries between tectonic plates, (1)---- is why countries such as Japan and Turkey experience them frequently. Although scientists cannot yet predict exactly (2)---- an earthquake will happen, they can identify high-risk areas. Buildings in these areas must be designed (3)---- strong shaking. Experience has shown that well-built structures can save thousands of lives. (4)----, many older buildings do not meet modern standards, and (5)---- them is expensive.

qs.e: Önceki cümlenin tamamını niteleyen virgüllü yapı: ", which is why…" = işte bu yüzden.
"Depremin tam olarak ne zaman olacağını" = when.
Amaç: "güçlü sarsıntıya dayanmak için tasarlanmalı" = to withstand.
Olumlu bilginin ardından olumsuz bir durum geliyor: Unfortunately.
Cümlenin öznesi bir eylem: "onları güçlendirmek pahalıdır" = strengthening them (gerund özne).
